page_title: MOR 0-0 CRO | Morocco v Croatia 23/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Luka Modric (Croatia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+6' Fernando Rapallini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Selim Amallah (Morocco) and blew his whistle. Croatia win a free kick.
90+5' Ez Abde (Morocco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Fernando Rapallini saw the whole situation.
90+3' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) makes a slide tackle, but referee Fernando Rapallini blows for a foul.
90+1' Lovro Majer (Croatia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Ivan Perisic is replaced by Mislav Orsic (Croatia).
88' Yahya Attiat-Allal (Morocco) was too forceful with his tackle and Fernando Rapallini interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
85' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
83' The attendance is 59407.
81' The game has come to an end for Azzedine Ounahi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco).
81' Walid Regragui decides to make a substitution. Youssef En Nesyri will be replaced by Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco).
81' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
80' Luka Modric (Croatia) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
80' Selim Amallah (Morocco) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
79' Here's the change. Mateo Kovacic leaves the pitch and Lovro Majer (Croatia) comes on as a substitute.
78' Fernando Rapallini shows a yellow card to Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) for his blatant foul.
77' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
76' Ez Abde (Morocco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Marko Livaja (Croatia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' Luka Modric (Croatia) launches a cross from the corner, but Bono is alert to thwart the effort.

72' Marko Livaja (Croatia) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Croatia.
71' Luka Modric (Croatia) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
71' Luka Modric (Croatia) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Croatia.
71' Zlatko Dalic prepares a substitution. Andrej Kramaric is replaced by Marko Livaja (Croatia).
70' The game is interrupted. Ez Abde (Morocco) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
68' The Croatia players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Substitution. Ez Abde (Morocco) replaces Sofiane Boufal.
65' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Dominik Livakovic and he's equal to it.
64' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
64' Luka Modric (Croatia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Fernando Rapallini blows for a foul.
63' A pass from Yahya Attiat-Allal (Morocco) is intercepted by Dominik Livakovic and the move breaks down.
60' Walid Regragui is forced to make a change. Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) is unable to continue due to injury, Yahya Attiat-Allal comes on.
58' Luka Modric (Croatia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
56' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
54' Looks like Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
53' Dejan Lovren (Croatia) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
52' The corner from Luka Modric (Croatia) is intercepted by Bono.

52' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Croatia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' A header by Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) from very close range goes towards the left-hand post, but doesn't get past Dominik Livakovic, who makes a brilliant save.
51' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
51' Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle. Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' Fernando Rapallini has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco).
48' The game is interrupted as Ivan Perisic (Croatia) is flagged offside.
46' Zlatko Dalic makes a half-time substitution. Mario Pasalic comes on in place of Nikola Vlasic (Croatia).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Fernando Rapallini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Luka Modric (Croatia) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
45+1' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Bono with a brilliant diving save!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
40' Luka Modric (Croatia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
38' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
37' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Fernando Rapallini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
33' The ball is cleared after Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is behind the touchline and Croatia will take a throw-in.
31' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Poor challenge! Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) is penalised for tripping and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle.
27' A pass from Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) is intercepted by Bono and the move breaks down.
25' Foul! Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
24' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
22' Luka Modric (Croatia) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Croatia get a corner.
20' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
19' Luka Modric (Croatia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
18' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
17' What a long-range shot by Ivan Perisic (Croatia). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
15' Luka Modric (Croatia) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
13' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
10' Luka Modric (Croatia) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
9' Fernando Rapallini blows the whistle, Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) is penalised for a foul.

8' Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Fernando Rapallini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
7' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) works the corner short.
5' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Croatia have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) commits a rough challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.

The players are out at last! Morocco will take the kick-off.
Fernando Rapallini will officiate today.
